changes.title: PAYMENT INDICATOR MUST BE CO FOR CASH DISBURSEMENTS TRANSACTIONS
MERCHANT VOLUME INDICATOR MP IS VALID ONLY FOR US-ACQUIRED PURCHASE AND CREDIT VOUCHER ORIGINALS AND REVERSALS

changes.old: The Purchase Identifier must be left-justified and the first position cannot contain a space. If the Purchase Identifier Format field contains a value of 1 through 5, this field must not be all spaces.
changes.new: The Purchase Identifier must be left-justified and the first position cannot contain a space. If the Purchase Identifier Format field contains a value of 1, 3, 4, 5, or 6, Purchase Identifier must not be all spaces.

changes.old: PURCHASE IDENTIFIER FORMAT MUST BE SPACE, 0, 1, 3, 4 OR 5
changes.new: PURCHASE IDENTIFIER FORMAT MUST BE SPACE, 0, 1, 3, 4, 5, OR 6

changes.old: The Purchase Identifier Format field must contain a space, or 0, 1, 3, 4 or 5.
changes.new: The Purchase Identifier Format field must contain a space, or 0, 1, 3, 4, 5, or 6.

changes.old: Sales Draft – 2nd Presentment of Original and 2nd Presentment of Reversal | Account Funding – 2nd Presentment of Original and 2nd Presentment of Reversal | Credit Voucher/Account Funding CV – 2nd Presentment of Original and 2nd Presentment of Reversal | Original Credit – 2nd Presentment of Original and 2nd Presentment of Reversal | Cash Disbursement – 2nd Presentment of Original and 2nd Presentment of Reversal | Sales Draft – Chargebacks and Chargeback Reversals 1st and 2nd Presentments | Account Funding – Chargebacks and Chargeback Reversals 1st and 2nd Presentments | Credit Voucher/Account Funding CV – Chargebacks and Chargeback Reversals 1st and 2nd Presentments | Original Credit – Chargebacks and Chargeback Reversals 1st and 2nd Presentments | Cash Disbursement – Chargebacks and Chargeback Reversals 1st and 2nd Presentments
changes.new: Dispute Financials – Chargeback, representments, representment reversal, and chargeback reversals.

changes.old: REQUESTED PAYMENT SERVICE REQUIRES AUTH CHARACTERISTICS IND EQUALS B OR P. ACI IS: X
changes.new: REQUESTED PAYMENT SERVICE REQUIRES AUTH CHARACTERISTICS IND EQUAL TO P. ACI IS: X

changes.old: When the Requested Payment Service (RPS) field contains 3 or 5 (CPS/preferred customer), the ACI must contain a value of B (Tokenized e-commerce with mobile device) or P (card not present—preferred customer).
changes.new: When the Requested Payment Service (RPS) field contains 3 or 5 (CPS/preferred customer), the ACI must contain a value of P (card not present—preferred customer).

changes.old: PURCHASE ID FORMAT MUST BE SPACE, 0, 1, 3, 4, OR 5 FOR ORIGINALS AND REVERSALS
changes.new: PURCHASE ID FORMAT MUST BE SPACE, 0, 1, 3, 4, 5, OR 6 FOR ORIGINALS AND REVERSALS

changes.old: For TC 05, when the Usage Code is 1, the Purchase Identifier Format must contain one of the following values: Space = Free text item description or field not used 0 = Free text item description or field not used 1 = Order number 3 = Rental agreement number 4 = Hotel folio number 5 = Invoice number
changes.new: For TC 05, when the Usage Code is 1, the Purchase Identifier Format must contain one of the following values: Space = Free text item description or field not used 0 = Free text item description or field not used 1 = Order number 3 = Rental agreement number 4 = Hotel folio number 5 = Invoice number 6 = Pay ID for OCT transactions

changes.old: MERCHANT VOLUME MUST BE EQUAL TO SPACES, MP, 00, OR 01 TO 99 FOR US- ACQUIRED PURCHASES AND CREDIT VOUCHERS
changes.new: MERCHANT VOLUME INDICATOR MUST BE TWO ALPHANUMERIC CHARACTERS: SPACES, 0 TO 9 OR A TO Z.

changes.old: For purchase and credit transactions and their exception items submitted by U.S. acquirers that contain a TOR 5, the Merchant Volume Indicator must contain a valid value (that is, spaces, MP, 00, or 01 through 99).
changes.new: The Merchant Volume Indicator must contain a valid value (that is, SPACES, 0 to 9 or A to Z).

changes.old: REQUESTED PAYMENT SERVICE REQUIRES AUTH CHARACTERISTICS IND EQUAL B OR W. ACI IS: X
changes.new: REQUESTED PAYMENT SERVICE REQUIRES AUTH CHARACTERISTICS IND EQUAL TO W. ACI IS: X

changes.old: For U.S. Electronic Commerce Payment Service original sales drafts and reversals transactions, submitted combination of Mail/Telephone or Electronic Commerce Indicator and Authorization Characteristics Indicator is not valid. Only the following combinations are valid: l If ACI is B, MOTO ECI must be 5 l If ACI is U, MOTO ECI must be 5 l If ACI is S, MOTO ECI must be 6 l If ACI is W, MOTO ECI must be 7 l If MOTO ECI is 5, ACI must be B or U l If MOTO ECI is 6, ACI must be S For Bill Payment transactions (Market-Specific Authorization Data Indicator of B), submitted with MOTO/ECI of 7, the Authorization Characteristics Indicator must not be: l A (Card Present) l E (Card Present with merchant name and location data) l K (Card Present with key entry)
changes.new: For U.S. Electronic Commerce Payment Service original sales drafts and reversals transactions, submitted combination of Mail/Telephone or Electronic Commerce Indicator and Authorization Characteristics Indicator is not valid. Only the following combinations are valid: l If ACI is U, MOTO ECI must be 5 l If ACI is S, MOTO ECI must be 6 l If ACI is W, MOTO ECI must be 7 l If MOTO ECI is 5, ACI must be U l If MOTO ECI is 6, ACI must be S For Bill Payment transactions (Market-Specific Authorization Data Indicator of B), submitted with MOTO/ECI of 7, the Authorization Characteristics Indicator must not be: l A (Card Present) l E (Card Present with merchant name and location data) l K (Card Present with key entry)
